blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models increasingly write the explanations people receive when a rule system denies their request. If several rules deny the request independently, an explanation can name a true reason and still leave the person denied after they fix it. We call the missing property recourse validity: changing what the explanation cites, without changing what was asked for, can flip the decision. We compute it exactly, and a hitting-set argument predicts from the policy alone when a correct reason fails. In six of seven rule systems ported from access control and US benefit eligibility, a single correct reason almost never gives recourse when several reasons apply. Across 20 LLMs, checks of whether the cited reasons are correct, computed or asked of an LLM judge, are close to chance at spotting this failure, as the argument predicts. A strong judge asked whether acting on the explanation would work does spot it. Stronger and reasoning models do better but still fail on many denials with four or more independent reasons. Asking for every rule helps every open model with room to improve. Explanations of eligibility decisions should be built from the decision function and judged by whether acting on them works.
blocks.zh: 当一个规则系统拒绝人们的要求时,语言模型越来越多地撰写人们得到的解释. 如果有几项规则独立地拒绝请求,解释可以说明一个真实的理由,在被否决的人修好后仍然离开. 我们称缺失的财产追索有效性:改变解释所引用的内容,而不改变要求的内容,可以推翻裁决。 我们精确地计算它,一个命中点定的论据从政策中仅预测一个正确的理由失败时. 在7个规则系统中,有6个从准入控制和美国福利资格中转出,在适用若干理由时,一个单一的正确理由几乎从未给予追索权。 在20个法学硕士中,核查所列举的理由是否正确、计算或向法学硕士法官提出询问,正如论点所预测的那样,几乎有可能发现这一失败。 一位强有力的法官问,根据解释采取行动是否可行。 更强壮的推理模式做得更好,但在许多有四个或更多独立原因的否认上仍然失败. 要求每一个规则,帮助每一个开放的模型,有改进的余地. 对资格决定的解释应依据决定职能,并根据是否根据决定采取行动来判断。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Rule systems decide many requests people make. Cedar and OPA Gatekeeper admit or reject API calls and Kubernetes pods. Benefit agencies apply eligibility rules for food assistance, public housing and student aid. The decision is exact, but the explanation a person reads is more and more often generated by an LLM from the policy text and the request ( Inan et al., 2023 ; Rebedea et al., 2023 ) . Data-protection law asks that automated decisions come with meaningful information about the logic involved ( Wachter et al., 2017 ; Goodman and Flaxman, 2017 ) , and work on algorithmic recourse asks more: that an explanation tell the person what they could change to obtain a different outcome ( Wachter et al., 2018 ; Ustun et al., 2019 ; Karimi et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 规则系统决定了人们提出的许多要求. Cedar和OPA守门员承认或拒绝API的电话和Kubernetes的舱位. 福利机构适用粮食援助、公共住房和学生援助的资格规则。 裁决是准确的,但一个人所读的解释越来越多地是由政策文本和请求的LLM产生的(Ian等人,2023年;Rebedea等人,2023年)。 数据保护法要求自动决定要包含有关逻辑的有意义的信息(Wachter等人,2017年;Goodman and Flaxman,2017年),关于算法追索的工作更要求:一个解释要告诉当事人可以改变什么以获得不同结果(Wachter等人,2018年;Ustun等人,2019年;Karimi等人,2022年).

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows a case from our benchmark. A family applying for public housing has net assets above the limit and also owns a home suitable for occupancy, and under HUD’s rules each fact bars admission on its own. Gemma-4-12B, given the rules and the application, explains that the family’s assets exceed the limit. The explanation is true, cites the right regulation and names a rule that fired. A family that acts on it, brings its assets under the limit and reapplies is denied again, this time because it owns a home.

blocks.en: Existing evaluations reward this explanation. Faithfulness tests ask whether an explanation reflects the process behind the decision ( Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ; Atanasova et al., 2023 ; Parcalabescu and Frank, 2024 ) , and it does. Simulatability asks whether a reader can predict the decision ( Hase and Bansal, 2020 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . Causal recall against an exact oracle ( V, 2026 ) credits the best coverage of any single reason, so this explanation scores 1. An LLM judge asked whether the reasons are correct has no reason to object. None of these asks whether acting on the explanation changes the outcome.

blocks.en: We define that property and compute it exactly from the decision function, given the features an extractor reads from each explanation. An explanation is recourse-valid if some change to the features it cites, holding fixed what the requester is asking for, flips the decision; equivalently, the cited features contain a contrastive explanation restricted to what the requester may change. One reason gives recourse if and only if it shares a feature with every other goal-fixed reason (Proposition 1 , the hitting-set duality of formal explanation restated with goals), so the failure is predictable from the policy alone. In six of seven ported rule systems, no single correct reason gives recourse in 0.95 to 1.00 of the denials with two or more goal-fixed reasons (§ 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们从决定功能中界定财产并精确地计算财产,因为每个解释都有一个摘录。 如果对其所列举的特征作一些改变,持有固定的要求,推翻裁决,则解释是有效的;同样,所引用的特征包含一个相反的解释,仅限于请求者可能改变什么。 一种理由提供追索权,条件是而且只有在它与所有其他固定目标的理由(建议1, 正式解释的两重性与目标重述)具有相同特征时,才提供追索权,因此,仅从政策来看,失败是可以预测的。 在7个移植规则系统中,有6个系统没有单一的正确理由在0.95-1.00中以两个或两个以上固定目标的理由对拒绝给予追索权(第3节)。

blocks.en: We score 141,750 explanations from 20 LLMs, from 8B open models to frontier APIs (Figure 2 , Appendix K ). Model behaviour follows Corollary 1 . Citing a true reason predicts recourse on single-reason denials (AUROC 0.93, small open models) and in the one system whose reasons share a feature (0.78). On the other multi-reason denials every correctness signal sits near chance, with reasoning off or on, and recourse is predicted instead by how much of the reason structure an explanation covers (§ 5.1 ). LLM judges asked whether the reasons are correct pass nearly every explanation; a strong judge asked whether acting on it would work tracks the oracle (§ 5.3 ). Recourse validity tracks capability and reasoning: thinking lifts the four open models we ran with it from between 0.40 and 0.77 to between 0.89 and 0.99. It does not remove the failure: at four or more independent reasons, six of the nine reasoning runs, thinking-on and frontier, fall below 0.8 (§ 5.2 ). Asking for every rule narrows the gap for every open model that has one (§ 6 ), and advice works as written less often than recourse validity credits (§ 7 ).

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. Recourse validity, a criterion that asks whether what a natural-language explanation cites contains a goal-restricted contrastive explanation, exact given those features (§ 2 ). 2. A benchmark of 420 episodes over seven ported rule systems, with goal and immutable features for each port (§ 3 ). 3. A measurement over 20 LLMs. On multi-reason denials, correctness-style evaluation, including causal recall and an LLM judge asked about correctness, cannot tell explanations that give recourse from those that do not; a strong judge asked about the outcome can, and reasoning fails where independent reasons multiply (§ 5 ). 4. Mitigations ranked by the gap they close, and a test of whether the advice works as written (§ 6 , § 7 ).

blocks.en: Each port is an executable gate over categorical features that abstract the source’s predicates, keeps its source’s combination semantics, and records every omitted provision with the reason in the port file. Cedar contributes the document-cloud and GitHub example policies ( Cedar Policy, 2026 ) , Gatekeeper the allowed-repositories and privileged-containers templates ( Open Policy Agent, 2026 ) ; a single-container pod can violate each template at most once, so pods have three container slots. The eligibility ports encode SNAP ( USDA Food and Nutrition Administration, 2026 , 7 CFR 273;) for a one-person household, HUD public housing admission ( U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, 2026 , 24 CFR 960.201, 960.204 and 5.603 to 5.618;) and Title IV student aid ( U.S. Department of Education, 2026 , 34 CFR 668.32 to 668.35;) . A port script checks each provision against the outcome the regulation fixes and regenerates the port file byte for byte. Cedar’s tinytodo policy and the single-container Gatekeeper ports admit no multi-reason denial as ported, and we exclude them.
blocks.zh: 每个端口是一个可执行的闸门,它比绝对的特性更能抽象出源的上游,保持源的组合语义,并在端口文件中记录每一个省略的条文和理由. Cedar贡献了文档-cloud和GitHub实例政策(Cedar Policy, 2026年),守门员是允许的存储器和特权-集装箱模板(Open Policy Agent, 2026年);一个单容器吊舱最多可以违反每个模板一次,因此吊舱有三个容器插槽. 资格港编码为SNAP(USDA食品和营养管理局,2026年,7 CFR 273;),供单人家庭使用,HUD公共住房(美国住房和城市发展部,2026年,24 CFR 960.201、960.204和5.603至5.618;),第四编学生援助(美国教育部,2026年,34 CFR 668.32至668.35;) 一个端口脚本根据管理结果检查每个条款,并重新生成端口文件字节用于字节. 锡达的细小的托多政策以及单一集装箱守门港口都承认,

blocks.en: The goal is action for Cedar, aid_program for Title IV and is_update for the privileged-containers pod; the other ports have none. Immutable features follow the source text (Appendix N ). Every port’s context space is small enough to enumerate, and for each port we draw 30 multi-reason denials, which have two or more reasons with the goal free, and 30 single-reason controls uniformly without replacement from all its denials of each kind, with a fixed seed, 420 episodes in all. With the goal fixed, 186 of the 210 multi-reason episodes keep two or more reasons, 18 keep one and 6 have none, as do 7 controls, so no explanation of those 6 and 7 can give recourse; Cedar github-model has only 16 contexts with two or more goal-fixed reasons, and 13 of its 30 sampled episodes are among them. Rates are over episodes with a defined verdict.

In six of seven rule systems, no single correct reason gives recourse in 0.95 to 1.00 of the denials with two or more goal-fixed reasons, and a correct reason cited alone fails in 0.96 to 1.00 of (denial, reason) pairs (Table 1 ).
Cedar github-model is the negative control: its reasons share a role-membership feature, so by Corollary 1 every single reason succeeds, and the measured share is 0.00. blocks.en: Every prompt gives the request, the decision and the policy with one sentence stating its combination semantics. The default asks for 2 to 4 sentences for the audit log (Appendix B ). List-all also asks for every rule or missing permission that causes the denial. Requester asks for an explanation to the person who made the request, as long as it needs to be; we run it on the 11 small open models, Haiku and GPT-6 Luna, 13 in all. Free and free-all show the request and decision but not the policy, as when an LLM narrates a decision made by a system it cannot inspect. Section 6 adds four conditions on three small models: uncapped list-all, a counterfactual prompt that asks what the person should change, the oracle’s minimum change, and every reason (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 每个提示都给出请求,决定和政策,并加一句说明其组合语义. 默认要求为审计日志提供2至4句(附录B. List- all也要求获得导致拒绝的每一项规则或缺失的许可. 请求者要求向提出请求的人解释,只要需要;我们运行在11个小型开放模型上,海库和GPT-6 Luna,总共13个. 自由、自由地显示要求和决定,但不显示政策,因为当LLM叙述一个系统作出的决定时,它不能检查。 第6节在三个小模型上增加了四个条件:未封装的列表全部,一个反事实提示,询问人物应该改变什么,神谕的最小变化,以及每一个原因(附录B).

blocks.en: We run 20 models in three groups. Open, 8B to 21B (11): Llama-3.1-8B, Granite-4.2-8B, gpt-oss-20b, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Ministral-3-14B, Gemma-3-12B, Gemma-4-12B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen3-14B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3.5-9B and Phi-4-14B. Open, 27B to 32B (four): Gemma-3-27B, Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3.8-27B. Frontier (five): Claude Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6.1 Sol. Every model answers each prompt 5 times. Open models run 4-bit through ollama on two T4 GPUs at temperature 0.8, with at most 400 new tokens and thinking off; 13% of Granite-4.2-8B’s answers reach that cap and at most 1% of any other model’s. gpt-oss-20b ( OpenAI, 2025 ) cannot turn reasoning off, so it runs at low reasoning effort with a 1,500-token budget that includes the hidden reasoning; 0% of its answers reach it, the longest at 458 tokens. Frontier models run through vendor interfaces at low reasoning effort (Haiku at its default) without temperature control. Large and frontier models answer the 210 multi-reason denials, the others all 420 episodes. With 8-bit weights, default and list-all recourse validity of Llama-3.1-8B and Gemma-3-12B move by − - 0.06 to 0.09, so 4-bit quantisation does not drive the small models’ rates.

blocks.zh: 5.1 正确性检查错过失败

Circles: 20,375 default explanations of multi-reason denials from all 20 models; squares: 4,072 thinking-on explanations; triangles: single-reason controls, small open models. Judges are GPT-6 Luna on a sample (§ 5.3 ). Within-model and within-episode values are in Table 8 .

blocks.en:
Table 5 in Appendix E gives every model. Fidelity runs from 0.74 to 0.97 and recourse validity from 0.23 to 0.99.
Corollary 1 says when a correct reason should predict recourse: on a single-reason denial, citing the true reason is what recourse needs; on a multi-reason denial whose reasons share no feature, it is not enough. Model behaviour follows the prediction. For the small open models, fidelity separates recourse-valid explanations at AUROC 0.93 [0.91, 0.94] on the single-reason controls and at 0.49 [0.48, 0.51] on the multi-reason denials. Among the multi-reason systems it predicts recourse only on Cedar github-model, whose reasons share a feature, at 0.78 [0.75, 0.80], against 0.50 to 0.57 on the other six. Over all 20 models, the three correctness signals separate recourse-valid explanations of multi-reason denials near chance (Figure 3 ): fidelity at AUROC 0.49 [0.47, 0.50], causal recall at 0.48 and causal precision at 0.48. Within a model it ranges from 0.42 to 0.64. The blind spot does not depend on how often models fail. On the 4,072 thinking-on explanations, 93% of them recourse-valid, fidelity separates at 0.49 [0.46, 0.52] and causal recall at 0.48, while coverage still reaches 0.75. Of the 17,859 explanations with causal recall 1, 37% leave the requester denied, up to 79% for Gemma-3-12B.
blocks.zh:
附录中的表5 E给每个模型。 薪酬从0.74到0.97,追索效力从0.23到0.99。
编年史第1卷说,当一个正确的理由可以预测追索:一个单一理由的拒绝,引用真正的理由是追索需要什么;一个多理由的拒绝,其理由没有特点,但这是不够的。 模型行为遵循预测. 对于小型开放型号,忠诚性在AUROC 0.93 [0.91, 0.94]关于单一理由控制的解释和在0.49 [0.48, 0.51] 关于多理由否认的解释中分别列出追索有效解释。 在多理由系统中,它只预测Cedar github-model的追索权,其理由具有0.78[0.75,0.80]这一特征,而其他6个则有0.50至0.57。 在所有20种模型中,三种正确性分别表明对近乎偶然的多重理由否定的追索有效解释(图3):忠诚度在AUROC 0.39 [0.47,0.50],因果召回0.48,因果精确度在0.48. 在模型中,从0.42到0.64不等。 盲点并不取决于模型的故障频率. 在4,072个思考中的解释中,其中93%是追索有效、忠诚分离为0.49[0.46,0.52],因果召回为0.48,而覆盖率仍然达到0.75。 在17,859个解释中,1个原因召回,37%离开请求者被拒绝,Gemma-3-12B高达79%.

blocks.en: Coverage of the reason structure predicts recourse instead. An explanation that covers one goal-fixed reason in full is recourse-valid in 0.49 of cases, no more often than one that covers none (0.48); one that covers two or more is valid in 0.75. Within an episode, coverage and the number of facts cited reach AUROC 0.83 and 0.87. In a logistic model with model fixed effects and episode-clustered errors, fidelity’s coefficient is indistinguishable from zero once coverage and facts cited are known ( − - 0.46, 95% CI [ − - 2.55, 1.63]), while both of those carry information ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Covering every reason implies recourse by Proposition 1 , so the coverage term is partly definitional; the informative result is the fidelity term.
blocks.zh: 理由结构的覆盖面预测的是追索权。 完全涵盖一个目标固定原因的解释是,在0.49个案件中,追索权是有效的,不超过一个不涵盖(0.48);一个涵盖两个或两个以上的解释在0.75中有效。 在一集中,报道和引用的事实数量达到AUROC 0.83和0.87。 在一个具有模型固定效应和插座错误的物流模型中,一旦覆盖和所引用的事实已知(− - 046,95% CI [− - 2.55,1.63 ) , 忠诚系数与零是分不开的,而两者都载有信息(p < 0.001 p < 0.001 ) 。 覆盖每个原因都意味着提案1的追索权,因此覆盖面一词是部分定义性的;信息结果是忠诚一词。

blocks.en: Two nulls separate which facts a model chooses from how many it cites. A random citation of as many facts of the episode gives less recourse than every model does, by 0.04 for Mistral-Nemo-12B to 0.70 for Gemma-4-31B; for Gemma-3-12B and Mistral-Nemo-12B the 95% interval reaches the random rate. A random draw of as many facts from those that belong to some reason is the stronger null, and every one of the 11 small open models falls below it, by as much as 0.26 for Llama-3.1-8B; the frontier models sit at it (margins of − - 0.001 to 0.05). The negative control behaves as predicted: on the 13 Cedar github-model episodes that keep two or more goal-fixed reasons, which share a feature, the small open models give recourse in 0.87 on average, and over all its episodes the system has the highest default recourse validity of the seven (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 一个模型从它引用的数中选择的事实 分两个空。 随机引用剧集的众多事实给出的追索权比每个模型都少,以0.04的Mistral-Nemo-12B到0.70的Gemma-4-31B;对Gemma-3-12B和Mistral-Nemo-12B来说,95%的间隔达到随机速率. 从属于某种原因的事实中随机抽取出同样多的事实是更强烈的虚无,11个小型开放模型中每一个都低于它,对Llama-3.1-8B来说高达0.26;边疆模型坐落在它身上(边距为−-0.001至0.05)。 负控行为如预言:在保持两个或两个以上守门原因的13个Cedar github-models上,小开放模式平均给出0.87的追索权,系统在所有各集中拥有7集(Appendix F.)的最高默认追索有效性.

blocks.en: Recourse validity tracks capability. Across the 15 models with a published Epoch Capabilities Index ( Epoch AI, 2025 ) it follows that index, Spearman 0.88 [0.64, 0.96], and across the 10 open models alone 0.71 [0.06, 0.92] (Appendix L ); among the seven small open models with an index it does not separate them (0.54, p = 0.23 p=0.23 ). The frontier models give recourse in 0.92 to 0.99 of multi-reason denials, the open models of 27B to 32B in 0.44 to 0.97, and those of 8B to 21B in 0.23 to 0.70. Models of similar capability still differ widely. The five models with an index between 138 and 143 range from 0.40 to 0.97: Qwen3-14B, Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3-32B at the bottom, Haiku and Gemma-4-31B at the top. Reasoning explains much of the band. With thinking on (gpt-oss-20b at high effort) and a 3,000-token budget that no answer reaches, Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3.8-27B and gpt-oss-20b rise from between 0.40 and 0.77 to between 0.89 and 0.99, against 0.92 for the weakest frontier model. Length accounts for little of the gain: thinking adds 0.5 to 0.9 cited facts and moves causal precision by − - 0.04 to 0.07.
blocks.zh: 路径有效性跟踪能力. 在整个15个模型中,Epoch Capabilitys Index(Epoch AI,2025年)采用了该指数Spearman 0.88 [0.64,0.96],在10个开放模型中,仅0.71 [0.06,0.92] (附录L);在7个有指数的小型开放模型中,它没有将它们分开(0.54,p=0.23 p=0.23)。 前沿模型给出了0.92到0.99的多种理由否定的追索权,0.44到0.97的27B到32B的开放模型和0.23到0.70的8B到21B的开放模型. 类似能力的模型仍然大不相同。 指数在138-143之间的5种型号从0.40到0.97不等:下方为Quen3-14B,Quen3.5-9B和Quen3-32B,上方为Haiku和Gemma-4-31B. 理性解释了乐队的大部分内容. 随着思考(gpt-oss-20b在高强度下)和3000托肯预算,没有回答到达,Qune3-14B,Qune3-32B,Qune3.8-27B和gpt-oss-20b从0.40到0.77之间上升至0.89到0.99之间,而最薄弱的边疆模式为0.92. 长度是收益的极小部分:思维将引用的事实增加0.5到0.9,并将因果精确度移到−-0.04到0.07.

blocks.en:
Recourse falls as reasons multiply, for every group (Figure 4 ). Under list-all, the small open models reach 0.90 at two goal-fixed reasons and 0.43 at four or more, where a valid explanation must change 4.5 features on average. Reasoning does not remove this. At two goal-fixed reasons the thinking-on models give recourse in 0.94 to 1.00 of denials, at four or more in 0.62 to 0.94; the frontier models average 0.84 there, the weakest 0.76, and six of the nine reasoning runs fall below 0.8. Mayne et al. (2025) find no benefit from inference-time compute for self-generated counterfactuals; here reasoning helps until the independent reasons multiply, which is where Corollary 1 says one reason, or two, stops being enough.
More reasoning effort narrows the fall for the strongest models only. Rerun at high effort on these denials, Sonnet gives recourse in 0.93 [0.86, 0.98] and GPT-6 Luna in 0.88, but Haiku in 0.78, up from 0.76 for all three at low effort, where GPT-6 Luna spent no reasoning tokens on a test prompt.
blocks.zh:
对每个群体来说,因理由倍增而引起追索(图4)。 在全列表下,小型开放型号在两个定门原因下达到0.90,在四个或四个以上时达到0.43,其中有效的解释必须平均改变4.5个特征. 理由不能消除这一点。 有两个固定目标的原因,即思维模型在0.94至1.00的拒绝中给予追索权,在0.62至0.94中给予4个或更多;前沿模型平均0.84,其中最弱的0.76,9个推理中的6个低于0.8。 Mayne等人(2025年)对于自生自灭的反事实,没有从推论时间计算得到任何好处;在此推理帮助,直到独立理由倍增,这就是Corollary 1说一个理由,或者两个理由,停止足够.
更多的推理努力缩小了只有最强模型的倒数. 对于这些否认,索内特在高努力下重新运行,在0.93 [0.86,0.98] 和0.88 中GPT-6 Luna 的追索权,但在0.78 中Haiku从 0.76 中上升至所有三个低努力,GPT-6 Luna 没有在测试提示上花费推理符.

Bold: mean over a group’s models; faint: one line per model. Thinking on: Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3.8-27B, and gpt-oss-20b at high effort. Per-bucket values are in Table 7 .

blocks.en: On the eligibility systems we also report RV A \mathrm{RV}_{A} , which holds fixed what an applicant cannot change, such as citizenship. It is defined on only 13, 13 and 7 of the 30 sampled SNAP, Title IV and HUD denials, so these rates rest on few episodes: the small open models give actionable recourse in 0.26 of Title IV and 0.36 of HUD denials on average, the open models of 27B to 32B in 0.60 and 0.69, and the frontier models in 0.96 and 0.98.
blocks.zh: 关于资格制度,我们还报告RV A\mathrm{RV}_{A},它持有固定的申请人不能改变的东西,例如公民身份。 在30个抽样的SNAP,第四篇和HUD拒绝书中,只有13,13和7个被定义,因此这些比率只停留在少数几起:小开放模式在第四篇0.26和0.36中平均给出了可诉追索权,开放模式在0.60和0.69中为27B至32B,前沿模式在0.96和0.98中.

blocks.en: The strongest open model needs the policy text. Without it, Gemma-4-31B, the one model of 27B or more we ran without the policy, falls from 0.97 to 0.58, and on HUD from 1.00 to 0.15.
blocks.zh: 最强开放模式需要政策文本. 没有它,Gemma-4-31B这个没有保险单的27B或更多型号就从0.97降至0.58,HUD从1.00降至0.15。

blocks.en: 5.3 Can an LLM judge stand in for the oracle?
blocks.zh: 5.3 一名LLM法官能代表神谕吗?

blocks.en: Table 2: LLM judges on default explanations of multi-reason denials, 20 per model and system, 2,800 per judge over 20 models. 4+ : share rated 4 or 5 on correct. AUROC: how well each 1 to 5 rating separates recourse-valid explanations from the rest; Difference : actionable minus quality AUROC, paired.
blocks.zh: 表2:对多种理由拒绝进行默认解释的LLM法官,每模式和系统20名,20名以上法官2 800名。 4+ : 股分排名正确为4或5. AUROC:每1至5级如何将追索有效解释与其余解释区分开来; 差异:可诉减质量 AUROC,对齐。

blocks.en: We gave three LLM judges ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) the case, the requester’s fixed goal and one explanation, and asked in one prompt for 1 to 5 ratings of whether its reasons are true, whether changing exactly the facts it names would get the request allowed, and its overall quality (Appendix B ). Asked whether the reasons are correct, the judges rate 84% to 89% of explanations 4 or 5, and the rating separates recourse-valid explanations at AUROC 0.56 to 0.62, 0.51 to 0.55 within a model (Table 2 ). It barely tracks fidelity either (AUROC 0.54 to 0.56), so a judge asked about correctness passes nearly everything. Asked whether acting on the explanation would work, GPT-6 Luna reaches AUROC 0.97 [0.96, 0.98] and Gemma-4-31B 0.92 [0.90, 0.94], and their mean ratings rank the models almost as the oracle does (Spearman 0.99 and 0.98); Qwen3.8-27B reaches 0.67. In the joint prompt, quality asked right after the outcome question does about as well (Table 2 ). Asked one question per call, on 700 of the explanations it had already rated, Luna reaches 0.97 [0.95, 0.98] on the outcome question, as in the joint prompt (0.96), but 0.89 [0.86, 0.91] on quality, down from 0.94: part of the quality rating’s strength came from the question asked before it. Leaving out each judge’s own explanations moves no AUROC by more than 0.005. So the correctness question fails, and only the exact check shows which judge is strong enough to ask about the outcome.
blocks.zh: 我们给出了三名LLM法官(Zheng等人,2023年)的案件,请求者的固定目标及一个解释,并在一个提示中询问其理由是否真实,是否确切改变其命名的事实是否会得到允许,以及其整体质量(附录B). 被问及理由是否正确,法官将84%至89%的解释4或5, 评分将AUROC 0.56至0.62、0.51至0.55中的可追索性解释分开(表2)。 因此一名法官问及是否正确, 有人问,GPT-6 Luna在解释上是否可行,它达到AUROC 0.97 [0.96, 0.98] 和 Gemma-4-31B 0.92 [0.90, 0.94], 其平均评级几乎与甲骨文一样(Spearman 0.99和0.98); Qune3.8-27B 达到 0.67。 在联合提示中,在结果问题之后也提出了质量问题(表2)。 Luna根据他已经评分的700种解释,每通电话就问一个问题,结果问题就达到0.97[0.95,0.98],如联合提示(0.96),但质量问题则比0.94低0.89[0.86,0.91]:质量评级的部分强度来自向其提出的问题。 留下每位法官自己的解释不会超过0.005。 因此正确性问题失败了,只有准确的检查显示哪个法官足够强大,可以询问结果.

blocks.en: 6 Mitigations
blocks.zh: 6 缓解措施

blocks.en: On the three models of Table 9 (Appendix J ), a prompt that asks the model to tell the person exactly what would need to change leaves recourse validity within − - 0.06 to 0.02 of the default.
blocks.zh: 在表9的三种模型(附录J)上,一个提示要求模型确切地告诉当事人需要改变什么,在−−0.06到0.02的默认内留下追索有效性.

blocks.en: One task sentence raises recourse validity for every open model whose default is below 0.90, 14 models, by 0.14 for Gemma-4-12B to 0.61 for Gemma-3-12B (paired sign-flip tests, every Holm-corrected p < 10 − 2 p<10^{-2} ), and the frontier models by at most 0.05. That closes 35% of the default’s gap for Phi-4-14B to 79% for Gemma-3-12B, under half for four models. List-all raises every small open model, to between 0.55 and 0.91, and for each it gains more than its extra facts buy at random. Reasoning and list-all add up. We ran list-all with thinking on for Qwen3-14B and gpt-oss-20b; it gives recourse in 0.97 to 0.98 of multi-reason denials, above either alone, and in 0.84 to 0.90 of those with four or more reasons, up from 0.62 to 0.79 for the same two models with thinking alone. The cost is length: the small open models’ list-all explanations cite 4.6 facts on average against 3.3 by default, and causal precision falls for ten of the 11 small open models.
blocks.zh: 一个任务句提高了默认值低于0.90,14个型号的每个开放型号的追索有效性,Gemma-4-12B的追索有效性为0.14,Gemma-3-12B的追索有效性为0.61(paired sign-flip tests,每个Holm校正的p < 10 - 2 p < 10^{-2}),边框型号的追索有效性最高为0.05. 这使得Phi-4-14B的默认缺口缩小了35%,Gemma-3-12B的缺口缩小了79%,低于四个模型的一半。 List-all将每个小型开放模型提升到0.55至0.91之间,每个模型的收益超过其随机购买的额外事实。 理由和列表加起来。 我们为Qune3-14B和gpt-oss-20b进行了全面思考;它给出了0.97至0.98的多理由否认,高于单独一个,在0.84至0.90的有四个或更多理由的拒绝,从0.62增至0.79,用于单独思考的同一两个模式。 成本是长度的:小型开放型号的列表全部解释平均引用4.6个事实,默认引用3.3个,11个小型开放型号中的10个是因果精确度。

blocks.en: The default asks for a short note for the audit log. Asked instead to explain the denial to the person who made the request, at any length, nine of the 11 small open models we ran give more recourse, 0.14 more on average, and ten still give less than when asked for every rule, by 0.16 on average; Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-6 Luna move by at most 0.002. The audit-log framing explains less than half of the gap. Most of the gain comes from length: on the three ladder models, addressing the person with the 2 to 4 sentence cap kept moves recourse validity by − - 0.03 to 0.04 from the default, and lifting the cap adds 0.10 to 0.25.
blocks.zh: 默认请求为审计日志提供简短的说明. 相反,要求向提出请求的人解释拒绝的问题,无论时间长短,我们运行的11个小型开放型号中有9个给出了更多的追索权,平均增加0.14个,10个仍然比要求每项规则时少,平均增加0.16个;克劳德·海库4.5和GPT-6 Luna最多增加0.02个。 审计记录框架解释了不足一半的差距。 收益大多来自长度:在三个阶梯模型上,针对持有2至4句封顶的人,将追索有效性从默认的− - 0.03 到 0.04 移动,取消封顶后增加0.10到0.25.

blocks.en: A deployer that owns the decision function can put its reasons in the prompt. Only oracle content is both complete and precise: default and counterfactual prompts give less recourse than either oracle condition, and the list-all prompts less precision. Handed every reason, the three models average 0.95, the most of any rung for each and 0.08 to 0.29 above the minimum change, where the extractor misses a feature named verbatim in 2% to 8% of explanations.
blocks.zh: 拥有决定功能的部署者可以将其理由及时提出. 只有oracle内容既完整又准确:默认和反事实提示给出的追索权比oracle条件中任何一个都少,列表全部提示的追索权更不精确. 三个模型平均为0.95, 其中每个模型最多为0.08到0.29, 并且比最小变化多, 其中提取器忽略了一个以2%到8%的解释为逐字记录的功能。

blocks.en: 7 Does the advice work as written?
blocks.zh: 页:1 咨询意见能用吗?

blocks.en: RV \mathrm{RV} credits any change to the cited features. To test advice as written, a second extraction pass reads the concrete changes an explanation proposes, each a feature and a new value from its domain (Appendix B ), and the decision function runs on the request with exactly those changes; a change to a goal feature is dropped. We run it on the three ladder models (Qwen3-14B, Gemma-3-12B, Llama-3.1-8B) under the counterfactual and minimum-change prompts of Section 6 , and on the requester prompt. Under the first, 0.81 to 0.86 of explanations propose a usable change, yet applying it gets the request allowed in only 0.17 to 0.21, against recourse validity of 0.25 to 0.34 on the same explanations. Advice from an explanation that fails RV \mathrm{RV} works in at most 0.02 of cases, and from one that passes in 0.59 to 0.64, so under this prompt RV \mathrm{RV} is close to a necessary condition for working advice and an optimistic bound on it. Handed the minimum change, their advice works in 0.30 to 0.69 of explanations against RV \mathrm{RV} of 0.58 to 0.90, and advice from explanations that fail RV \mathrm{RV} works in up to 0.24. Every one of those 83 cases changes a fact the explanation offers as advice but does not present as a reason, so the reason extractor rightly leaves it out, since RV \mathrm{RV} scores only the reasons an explanation gives. Addressed to the person, the 13 requester models give advice that works as written in 0.08 to 0.56 of explanations, against RV \mathrm{RV} of 0.37 to 0.95; for no model does it reach four fifths of what RV \mathrm{RV} credits.
blocks.zh: RV\mathrm{RV} 将引用的特性的更改记为 。 为了测试书面的建议,第二个提取通行证读取了具体修改,一个解释建议,每个功能和来自其域的新值(附录B),决定函数运行在请求上,正好有这些修改;一个目标特征的修改被放弃. 我们运行在三个阶梯模型上(Quen3-14B,Gemma-3-12B,Llama-3.1-8B),在6节的反事实和最小变化提示下运行,在请求者提示下运行. 第一项解释(0.81至0.86)提议作出可用改动,但适用这项解释时只允许在0.17至0.21之间提出请求,而同一解释的追索效力为0.25至0.34。 从一个解释中得出的意见,如果RV\mathrm{RV}在最多0.02个案件中起作用,从0.59个案件到0.64个案件无效,那么在这个迅速的RV\mathrm{RV}下,就接近一个必要的工作建议条件,并且对此有一个乐观的约束。 将最小的改变交给了他们,他们的建议工作在0.30到0.69对\mathrm{RV}的解释中为0.58到0.90,来自解释中未能做到\mathrm{RV}的建议工作在0.24. 这83起案件中的每一起案件都改变一个事实,解释作为建议提出,但没有作为理由提出,因此,理由提取器正确地将其排除在外,因为RV\mathrm{RV}只给出解释给出的理由。 13个请求者模型针对个人,给出了以0.08至0.56解释书写成的建议,反对0.37至0.95的RV\mathrm{RV};因为没有模型能够达到RV\mathrm{RV}信用的五分之四.

blocks.en: 8 Related work
blocks.zh: 8 相关工作

blocks.en: Faithfulness tests ask whether an explanation reflects what drove the explained model ( Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ; Atanasova et al., 2023 ; Parcalabescu and Frank, 2024 ) , and LLM explanations often leave out influential factors or do not suffice for the output ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Matton et al., 2025 ; Nguyen et al., 2026 ) ; Pawar et al. (2026) test whether changing one cited factor changes the LLM’s own decision. Simulatability and utility studies ask whether a reader can predict outputs or solve new cases ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Joshi et al., 2023 ) . Each measures an explanation against the model that produced it. We measure it against an external rule system, where independent reasons give every single factor zero necessity. LLM judges are lenient and near chance against objective labels ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , and they detect incomplete justifications of rule-governed decisions near chance ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) ; we find the same for the correctness question and show that the outcome question restores the signal. V (2026) score explanations of one synthetic tool-call gate against its exact minimal sufficient reasons; we use that gate only in Appendix C , and its causal recall is one of the correctness signals we find uninformative about recourse.
blocks.zh: 忠诚度测试询问,解释是否反映了所解释的模型的驱动力(Jacovi和Goldberg,2020年;Atanasova等人,2023年;Parcalabescu和Frank,2024年),以及LLM解释是否经常忽略有影响力的因素或不足以输出(Turpin等人,2023年;Matton等人,2025年;Nguyen等人,2026年);Pawar等人(2026年)检验所引用的一个因素是否改变LLM本身的决定. 可模拟性和实用性研究询问读者是否能够预测产出或解决新病例(Chen等人,2024年;Joshi等人,2023年). 每一种衡量方法都与产生模型的模型相对应。 我们对照一种外部规则制度来衡量它,在这个制度中,独立的理由给每一个因素都带来了零必要性。 LLM评委对客观标签(郑等人,2023年;谭等人,2025年;陈等人,2026年)持宽大态度,近乎机会,他们发现统治裁决的不完全理由近乎偶然(赵等人,2026年);我们发现正确性问题也是一样,并表明结果问题恢复了信号. V(2026年)对一个合成工具呼叫门的分数解释与其确切的最低限度的充分理由相对照;我们仅在附录C中使用该门,其因果召回是我们认为关于追索的不灵的正确性信号之一.

blocks.en: Counterfactual explanations state what would have to change for a different outcome ( Wachter et al., 2018 ) , and recourse restricts the change to what a person can act on, including certifying when none exists ( Ustun et al., 2019 ; Karimi et al., 2022 ; Kothari et al., 2024 ) ; RV G \mathrm{RV}_{G} and RV A \mathrm{RV}_{A} carry these notions to the features a natural-language explanation cites. Reason codes assume a person can act on one reason at a time ( Barocas et al., 2020 ; Cheon et al., 2025 ) . LLMs’ own counterfactuals are often invalid or far from minimal ( Mayne et al., 2025 ; Dehghanighobadi et al., 2025 ) , less so in larger models ( Kalyvas et al., 2026 ) , but validity there is judged against the LLM’s own boundary. RGDT-Bench scores justifications for completeness against a reference warrant ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Recourse validity needs no reference and disagrees with completeness both ways: 23% of the recourse-valid explanations we score are incomplete, and a complete explanation whose reasons rest on immutable facts gives no actionable recourse.
blocks.zh: 反事实解释指出,对不同结果必须作出何种改变(Wachter等人,2018年),追索权将改变限制在一个人可以采取的行动上,包括证明不存在(Ustun等人,2019年;Karimi等人,2022年;Kothari等人,2024年);RV。 G\ mathrm{ RV}_{G} 和 RV 一个\ mathrm{ RV}_{A} 将这些概念带入自然语言解释所引用的特征 。 理由代码假设一个人可以一次以一个理由行事(Barocas等人,2020年;Cheon等人,2025年)。 LLMs本身的反事实往往无效或远非最低(Mayne等人,2025年;Dehghanighobadi等人,2025年),在更大的模型(Kalyvas等人,2026年)中则不那么如此,但根据LLM自己的边界判断其有效性. RGDT-Bench根据参考证对完整性进行评分(Zhao等人,2026年)。 追索权的有效性不需要参考,也不完全一致:我们得分的追索权有效解释有23%是不完整的,一个完全的解释,其依据是不可改变的事实,因此没有可诉的解释。

blocks.en: Rule benchmarks score whether LLMs reach the right decision from written rules ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Gui et al., 2025 ; Servantez et al., 2026 ) ; access-control systems have long computed what a denied requester could change ( Kapadia et al., 2004 ; Chowdary and Sural, 2026 ) . We fix the decision with an exact gate and score whether an LLM’s explanation of it gives recourse. Reasoning models collapse as puzzles and constraint problems grow ( Shojaee et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) ; the fall at four or more reasons is the same shape for explanations. Proposition 1 restates the hitting-set duality of diagnosis and formal explanation ( Reiter, 1987 ; Ignatiev et al., 2019b ; Ignatiev et al., 2021 ) with goal features fixed, and its shared-feature case is feature necessity ( Huang et al., 2023 ) . Appendix A gives a longer account.
blocks.zh: 规则基准根据书面规则(周等人,2025年;Gui等人,2025年;Servantez等人,2026年)对LLMs是否做出正确的决定进行评分;访问控制系统长期计算一个被拒绝的请求者可能改变什么(Kapadia等人,2004年;Chowdary and Sural,2026年)。 校对:Soup 随着谜题和制约问题的增长,理性模型崩溃(Shojaee等人,2025年;Lin等人,2025年);四个或四个以上原因的下降是解释的相同形状. 提案1重申了诊断和正式解释的命中二元性(Reiter,1987年;Ignatiev等人,2019年b;Ignatiev等人,2021年),目标特征固定,其共同特征案例为特征必要性(Huang等人,2023年). 附 录 A给一个更长的账户。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
An explanation of a rule-based denial can cite a true reason and still fail the person who acts on it, and checks of whether the reasons are correct, computed or asked of an LLM judge, cannot see this. Across 20 LLMs on seven ported rule systems, recourse validity tracks capability and reasoning, and falls as independent reasons multiply, for reasoning and frontier models too. Reasoning or asking for every rule closes much of the gap.
Explanations of eligibility decisions should be built from the decision function and evaluated by whether acting on them works.
blocks.zh:
对基于规则的拒绝的解释可以列举一个真实的理由,并且仍然使根据该理由行事的人失望,而核实理由是否正确、计算或向LLM法官提出,则看不出这一点。 7个端口规则系统的20个法学硕士学位、追索有效性跟踪能力和推理能力,作为推理和前沿模型的独立理由倍增。 解释或要求每项规则都弥补了大部分差距。
对资格决定的解释应从决定职能中制定,并通过是否根据决定采取行动加以评估。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Every model-side number passes through an LLM extractor, and Qwen3-14B also extracts its own explanations. A second extractor agrees with it at α \alpha of 0.83 to 0.90 and one author’s labels at 0.83; both move recourse validity by little, but one human annotator is weaker evidence than several, the extractors can share errors, and the pass that reads proposed changes in Section 7 has not been checked by hand.
blocks.zh: 每个模型侧数都通过LLM提取器,Qune3-14B也提取了自己的解释. 第二种提取器在 α\α 0.83 到 0.90 时同意它,一个作者的标签在 0.83 时也同意它;两者都很少移动追索有效性,但一个人类注释器比几个更弱的证据,提取器可以分享错误,读第7节中拟议修改的通行证没有经过手动检查.

blocks.en: RV \mathrm{RV} credits any assignment to the cited features, including ones the explanation never suggests, so it overstates how often acting on an explanation succeeds. Section 7 measures how far: recourse-valid counterfactual advice works as written in 0.59 to 0.64 of cases, so the gains it reports for a mitigation overstate gains in working advice. RV A \mathrm{RV}_{A} is defined on only 7 to 13 of the 30 sampled denials per eligibility system, since the rest admit no actionable recourse, and whether models tell an applicant that no change can help is not measured.
blocks.zh: RV\ mathrm{ RV} 将任何任务计入引用的特性, 包括解释从未暗示过的特性, 因此它过多地描述了根据解释采取行动的频率是否成功 。 第7节衡量了在多大程度上:在0.59至0.64个案件中,申诉有效反事实咨询起作用,因此,报告在工作咨询中,减少过度夸大的结果。 房车 \mathrm{RV}_{A}的定义是每个资格制度30个抽样拒绝中只有7至13个,因为其余的都承认没有可诉的追索权,以及模型是否告诉申请人任何改变都无济于事。

blocks.en: Each port folds its source’s predicates into a few categorical features. SNAP is modelled for a one-person household. The CFR lags statute, for SNAP after the 2025 reconciliation act and for Title IV after Workforce Pell, and the features abstract over the changed lists. Contexts are counted under the uniform measure, where most eligibility contexts are denials, so no count in Table 1 is a population rate. Goal and immutable features are our choice, and a different choice changes which denials count as multi-reason or as having actionable recourse.
blocks.zh: 每个端口将其源的上游折叠成几个绝对的特征. SNAP为单人家庭模式。 CFR为2025年和解法案之后的SNAP和劳动力交易之后的第四编的法规滞后,其特征抽象于已修改的清单。 根据统一衡量法计算背景情况,大多数资格情况为拒绝,因此表1中的任何计算都不是人口比率。 目标和不可改变的特征是我们的选择,而另一种选择则改变,拒绝将它视为多种理由或可诉诸行动。

blocks.en: Open models run 4-bit with thinking off, while the public capability index scores provider-hosted weights; we test 8-bit weights on two models and thinking on four, under the default prompt only, so the other conditions describe models that do not reason before answering. Thinking also raises the token budget (400 new tokens off, 3,000 on), though no default answer of the thinking-off Qwen models comes near the cap (the longest is 180 tokens) and none of gpt-oss-20b’s reaches its budget, so the budget does not explain the gain; three of the four thinking models are Qwen hybrids, and we did not read their reasoning traces, so we cannot say what reasoning changes. We dropped Qwen3.5-9B with thinking on because more than half of its answers ran out of the token budget before the explanation. The matched capability band separates model families as much as capability, and audience is separated from length on three small models only. Frontier models run at low reasoning effort through vendor interfaces without temperature control, and we reran three of them at high effort on the four-or-more-reason denials only; other settings may change their rates. Large and frontier models answer the multi-reason denials only. All prompts and rule systems are in English.
blocks.zh: 开放型号运行4-bit并进行思考,而公共能力指数则对提供者托管的权重进行评分;我们在两个模型上测试8-bit权重,并在四个模型上进行思考,仅在默认的提示下,所以其他条件描述了在回答前没有理由的模型. 思考也提高了象征性预算(400个新令牌关闭,3000 on),尽管思考的Quen模型没有默认的答案接近上限(最长的是180个令牌),而且gpt-oss-20b都没有达到预算,因此预算没有解释收益;四个思维模型中的三个是Quen混合体,我们没有读到他们的推理痕迹,因此我们不能说推理有什么变化. 我们放弃了 Quen3.5-9B 并思考,因为超过一半的答案 在解释之前就用光了象征性的预算。 匹配的能力波段将模范家庭与能力一样分开,受众仅从三个小模型上的长度分开. 边疆模型通过供应商接口进行低推理,而无需温度控制,我们只通过四或更多理由的拒绝,高强度地重新提出其中三个;其他设置可能改变它们的费率。 大型和前沿模式只能回答多原因的否认。 所有提示和规则系统都使用英语.

blocks.en: Three judges cannot map how judge quality varies across models, and judges saw a sample of 20 explanations per model and system. The simulated readers of Appendix M are language models, not people.
blocks.zh: 3名法官无法描绘不同模式法官的质量如何不同,法官看到每个模式和系统有20个解释样本。 附录M的模拟读者是语言模型,而不是人.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: One author labelled the extraction sample; no other person took part. The reader study uses language models as readers and collects no data from people.
blocks.zh: 一名作者标出了提取样品;没有其他人参加。 读者研究使用语言模型作为读者,不从人那里收集数据.

blocks.en: The Cedar examples and Gatekeeper library are Apache-2.0. The federal eligibility rules are public-domain works of the US government (17 U.S.C. 105). Every context is a synthetic feature combination. The eligibility ports are research abstractions, not eligibility determinations, and must not be used to advise applicants. Frontier models were called with provider data retention off where the interface allows it.
blocks.zh: 锡达的例子和守门员图书馆是Apache-2.0. 联邦资格规则是美国政府的公有领域作品(17 U.S.C. 105). 每个上下文都是合成特征组合. 资格口岸是研究抽象的,不是资格认定,不得用于向申请人提供咨询. 边疆模型被调用,在接口允许的地方保留提供者的数据。

blocks.en: We will release the ports and port scripts, the episodes, every prompt, generation, extraction and judge rating, the oracle, and the analysis code that writes every number in this paper.
blocks.zh: 我们将发布端口和端口脚本,剧集,每一个即时,生成,提取和判断评分,甲骨文,以及在本报中写每个数字的分析代码.

blocks.en: Disclosing every reason for an access-control denial tells a requester more about the policy, which can help an adversary probe it. For benefit denials the balance runs the other way. An applicant told one of three disqualifying reasons may fix it, reapply and be denied again, at a cost in time and lost benefits. Explanations of eligibility decisions should name every reason, or say that more than one applies.
blocks.zh: 揭开拒绝访问控制的一切原因,让请求者更多地了解了政策,这可以帮助对手探究. 为了剥夺福利,余额是相反的。 申请人告诉三个取消资格的理由之一,可以纠正、重新申请和再次被拒绝,费用要及时,而且丧失福利。 对资格决定的解释应列出所有理由,或说适用一个以上的理由。

blocks.en: Appendix A Extended related work
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: Faithfulness asks whether an explanation reflects how a decision was made ( Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ) . Tests insert reasons an explanation fails to mention or reconstruct the input from the stated reasons ( Atanasova et al., 2023 ) , weight each mention by how far it moves the explained model ( Siegel et al., 2024 ) , or check self-consistency, which is what most such tests measure ( Parcalabescu and Frank, 2024 ; Madsen et al., 2024 ) . Self-explanations are tuned for plausibility at some cost to faithfulness ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) , and the concepts an explanation names can differ from those that move the output ( Matton et al., 2025 ) . Chain-of-thought omits biasing features and hints the model used ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , models condition on their reasoning to different degrees ( Lanham et al., 2023 ; Tutek et al., 2025 ; Gur-Arieh et al., 2026 ) , and LLM explanations are selective, naming a subset of causes as people do ( Kunz and Kuhlmann, 2024 ) . Each of these compares an explanation with the model that produced it. In our setting the decision is made by an external rule system, so faithfulness to the explainer is not at issue: an explanation can be faithful to the rules and still give no recourse.
blocks.zh: Jacovi和Goldberg, 2020年。 测试插入一个解释没有提及或重新构建来自所陈述理由(Atanasova等人,2023年)的输入,每个说明的重量以它移动被解释模型的多远(Siegel等人,2024年)表示,或者检查自我一致性,这是大多数这种测试措施(Parcalabescu和Frank,2024年;Madsen等人,2024年)。 自我解释以某种代价取悦忠诚(Agarwal等人,2024年),解释性名称的概念可以与移动输出的概念不同(Matton等人,2025年)。 思维链省略了偏差特征,暗示了所使用的模型(Turpin等人,2023年;Chen等人,2025年),模型的推理条件不同,程度不同(Lanham等人,2023年;Tutek等人,2025年;Gur-Arieh等人,2026年),LLM解释是选择性的,将一个子集命名为人所做的事(Kunz和Kuhlmann,2024年). 每一份都比较一个解释与产生它的模式. 在我们的设定中,决定是由外部规则系统作出的,因此对解释者的忠诚是没有争议的:解释可以忠实于规则,仍然不给任何追索权.

blocks.en: Rationale benchmarks score comprehensiveness and sufficiency against the explained model ( DeYoung et al., 2020 ) ; with independent denial reasons, fixing one cited reason changes nothing, a failure these metrics cannot attribute to the explanation. Free-text LLM explanations are mostly insufficient for the model’s own output ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) , and Pawar et al. (2026) test whether each cited factor is necessary or sufficient for an LLM’s decision; under overdetermination every single factor has necessity zero, which Proposition 1 predicts from the policy. Simulatability asks whether an explanation helps a reader predict outputs ( Hase and Bansal, 2020 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Limpijankit et al., 2025 ) . Studies of human utility find that rationales help readers less than accuracy or similarity to gold rationales suggests ( Joshi et al., 2023 ) , that few explanation datasets suit decision studies ( Hashemi Chaleshtori et al., 2024 ) , and that readers over-rely on wrong explanations ( Si et al., 2024 ) . An incomplete but correct explanation carries the same risk, since the reader has no sign that a second reason exists. A position paper asks that self-explanations be judged on actionability ( Herrewijnen et al., 2026 ) ; recourse validity is one exact form of that judgement.
blocks.zh: 依据基准比照被解释模型(DeYoung等人,2020年)来评分全面性和充足性;有独立的否定理由,确定一个被引用的理由不会改变任何东西,一个失败,这些衡量标准不能归因于解释。 Free-text LLM解释对于模型本身的输出(Nguyen等人,2026年)和Pawar等人(2026年)来说,大多不足以检验每个引用的系数对于LLM的决定是否必要或足够;在过分确定下,每个因素都有必然的零,建议1从政策中预测. Simulatable问,解释是否有助于读者预测产出(Hase和Bansal,2020年;Chen等人,2024年;Limpijankit等人,2025年)。 对人类功用的研究发现,原理对读者的帮助不如对黄金原理的准确性或相似性(Joshi等人,2023年),解释数据集对决定研究的适合性很少(Hashim Chaleshtori等人,2024年),读者对错误解释的反感过大(Si等人,2024年)。 一个不完整但正确的解释也有同样的风险,因为读者没有迹象表明存在第二个原因。 一份立场文件要求根据可诉性来判断自我解释(Herrewijnen等人,2026年);追索有效性是这一判决的一种确切形式。

blocks.en: LLM judges agree with human raters on many generation tasks ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Chiang and Lee, 2023 ) , but favour the response shown first ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , their own outputs ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ) and fluent answers with factual errors ( Wu and Aji, 2025 ) , and their reliability varies with the property rated and the wording of the question ( Bavaresco et al., 2025 ; Thakur et al., 2025 ; Bellibatlu et al., 2026 ) . Against objective labels strong judges are close to chance ( Tan et al., 2025 ) , and judges that ignore surface edits miss most edits that change what is being judged ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . RGDT-Bench finds judges detect incomplete justifications of rule-governed decisions near chance ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Our correctness question behaves the same way. We add two findings: asking whether acting on the explanation would work restores the signal for a strong judge, and the exact oracle shows which judge is strong enough.
blocks.zh: LLM评委在很多世代任务(郑等人,2023年;刘等人,2023年;蒋和李,2023年)上都与人类评委意见一致,但赞成首先显示的答复(王等人,2024年),他们自己的产出(Panicksery等人,2024年)和有事实错误的流畅答案(吴和阿吉,2025年),其可靠性随财产的评级和问题的措辞而异(Bavaresco等人,2025年;Thakur等人,2025年;Bellibatlu等人,2026年). 反对客观标签的强势法官接近机会(Tan等人,2025年),忽视表面编辑的法官错过了大多数改变判决内容的编辑(Chen等人,2026年). RGDT-Bench认为,法官发现,对规则管理的裁决提出不完全的理由几乎是偶然的(Zhao等人,2026年)。 我们的正确性问题也一样 我们补充两个结论:询问根据解释采取行动是否有助于恢复一个强有力的法官的信号,确切的神谕显示哪个法官足够强大。

blocks.en:
People ask why an outcome happened rather than some other one ( Miller, 2019 ) . Counterfactual explanations state the smallest change that yields the preferred outcome ( Wachter et al., 2018 ) ; methods make them feasible ( Poyiadzi et al., 2020 ) or diverse ( Mothilal et al., 2020 ) , and recourse restricts them to what a person can act on, holding immutable features fixed and certifying when no change helps ( Ustun et al., 2019 ; Karimi et al., 2022 ; Verma et al., 2024 ; Kothari et al., 2024 ) . Recourse is owed to decision subjects as a matter of agency ( Venkatasubramanian and
Alfano, 2020 ) . Reason codes rest on the assumption that features can be changed one at a time ( Barocas et al., 2020 ) and often name features whose change cannot alter the decision ( Cheon et al., 2025 ) , though in user studies with single-reason denials they help people obtain recourse as often as counterfactuals ( Upadhyay et al., 2025 ) . Our failure is the multi-reason case, where any single reason, coded or counterfactual, fails.
blocks.zh:
人们会问为什么会有结果, 反事实解释指出产生偏好结果的最小变化(Wachter等人,2018年);方法使其可行(Poyiadzi等人,2020年)或多样化(Mothilal等人,2020年),并且追索限制于一个人可以采取的行动,持有固定不变的特征,并在无变化帮助时进行认证(Ustun等人,2019年;Karimi等人,2022年;Verma等人,2024年;Kothari等人,2024年)。 作为一种代理事项,对决策主体必须进行申诉(文卡塔苏布拉马尼安和
阿尔法诺, 2020 ). 理由代码基于一个假设,即特性可以一次改变(Barocas等人,2020年),而且经常是名称特征,其改变不能改变决定(Cheon等人,2025年),不过在使用单一理由否定的用户研究中,这些特性有助于人们像反事实一样经常获得求助(Upadhyay等人,2025年)。 我们的失败是多重原因, 任何单一的理由, 编码或反事实, 都失败。

blocks.en: The GDPR gives a right to be informed about the logic of automated decisions rather than an explanation of each ( Wachter et al., 2017 ) , and US explanation duties address inscrutable models more than scrutable ones ( Selbst and Barocas, 2018 ) ; our rule systems are fully scrutable and their explanations still fail. Regulation B requires adverse action notices to give the principal reasons and advises that more than four are unlikely to help the applicant ( Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, 2026 ) ; a notice that respects that guidance can still give no recourse when more reasons deny independently.
blocks.zh: GDPR赋予了了解自动化决定逻辑的权利,而不是对每个决定的解释(Wachter等人,2017年),而美国的解释义务则针对不可理解的模式,而不是不可理解的模式(Selbst和Barocas,2018年);我们的规则系统完全不可理解,其解释仍然失败. 条例 B要求负面行动通知给出主要理由,并告知超过4个不可能帮助申请人(消费者财务保护局,2026年);该通知尊重该指导在更多理由独立否认时仍不能给予追索权.

blocks.en: LLMs’ own counterfactuals are often invalid or far from minimal, judged against the LLM’s own boundary ( Mayne et al., 2025 ; Dehghanighobadi et al., 2025 ) , and their validity rises with scale ( Kalyvas et al., 2026 ) . LLMs also narrate the explanations of external classifiers ( Zytek et al., 2024 ) and propose recourse that a classifier checks inside the loop ( Tabei, 2026 ) . We score the free-text explanation a deployed model writes with no oracle in the loop. RGDT-Bench scores justifications of rule-governed decisions for completeness against reference warrants ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and a SAT check can verify that a benefits justification is consistent with statute ( Sunny and Sivan-Sevilla, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 根据LLM自己的边界(Mayne等人,2025年;Dehghanighobadi等人,2025年)判断,LLM本身的反事实往往无效或远远不够,其有效性随规模而上升(Kalyvas等人,2026年)。 LLMS还讲述了外部分类者的解释(Zytek等人,2024年),并提出一个分类者在循环内检查的追索权(Tabei,2026年). 我们得到的自由文字解释 一个部署的模型写 循环中没有任何先知。 RGDT-Bench根据参考授权书对规则管理的决定作出完整性的评分(Zhao等人,2026年),SAT检查可以核实一项效益说明符合法规(Sunny和Sivan-Sevilla,2026年)。

blocks.en: LLMs are tested on applying written rules: fees, trades and tax ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , rule-defined games ( Gui et al., 2025 ) , statutes ( Holzenberger et al., 2020 ; Blair-Stanek et al., 2023 ; Guha et al., 2023 ) and bankruptcy exemptions generated from symbolic rules ( Servantez et al., 2026 ) . Benefit agencies use LLMs to turn SNAP and Medicaid policy into code, which is accurate but incomplete ( Kennan et al., 2025 ) ; caseworkers follow chatbot answers on SNAP questions ( Gosciak et al., 2026 ) ; and LLMs draft Cedar policies under a verifier ( Vatsa et al., 2026 ) . Guardrail systems explain refusals in natural language ( Inan et al., 2023 ; Rebedea et al., 2023 ) . Access-control systems have long computed the changes that would turn a denial into a grant ( Kapadia et al., 2004 ) , recently weighted by how changeable each attribute is ( Chowdary and Sural, 2026 ) . These works score decisions or compute feedback; we score whether an LLM’s explanation of a fixed decision gives recourse.
blocks.zh: LLMs通过应用书面规则进行测试:收费,行业和税收(周等人,2025年),规则定义游戏(桂等人,2025年),法规. (Holzenberger等人,2020年;Blair-Stanek等人,2023年;Guha等人,2023年)和象征性规则产生的破产豁免(Servantez等人,2026年). 福利机构利用LLMs将SNAP和Medicaid政策转化为代码,该代码是准确但不完整的(Kennan等人,2025年);个案工作者遵循关于SNAP问题的聊天人解答(Gosciak等人,2026年);LLMs在核查人指导下起草Cedar政策(Vatsa等人,2026年)。 Guardrail系统用自然语言解释拒绝(Ian等人,2023年;Rebedea等人,2023年). 访问控制系统长期以来计算了将拒绝变成赠款的变化(Kapadia等人,2004年),最近按每个属性的可变性进行了加权(Chodary和Sural,2026年)。 这些作品评分决定或计算反馈;我们评分LLM对固定决定的解释是否给予追索权.

blocks.en: Open models expose reasoning as a switch, a token budget or an effort level ( Yang et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2025 ) . The accuracy of reasoning models falls as puzzles and constraint problems grow ( Shojaee et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) , longer reasoning can lower accuracy on deduction with many constraints ( Gema et al., 2025 ) , and chain-of-thought can hurt instruction following ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Mayne et al. (2025) find no gain from inference-time compute for self-generated counterfactuals. Against an external rule system we find a large gain that fades as the number of independent reasons grows.
blocks.zh: 开放模型将推理暴露为开关、象征性预算或努力水平(Yang等人,2025年;OpenAI,2025年)。 推理模型的准确性随着谜题和制约问题的增长而下降(Shojaee等人,2025年;Lin等人,2025年),较长的推理可以降低扣除时的准确性,但受到许多制约(Gema等人,2025年),思维链可以伤害后续的指令(Li等人,2025年). Mayne等人(2025年)认为,自产生反事实的推论-时间计算没有任何好处. 在外部规则体系下,我们发现一个巨大的收益随着独立理由数量的增加而逐渐消失。

blocks.en: Diagnoses are the minimal hitting sets of conflicts ( Reiter, 1987 ) , and minimal unsatisfiable and minimal correction subsets are dual in the same way ( Liffiton and Sakallah, 2008 ) . The duality was carried to classifier explanations ( Ignatiev et al., 2019b ) and stated between abductive and contrastive explanations ( Ignatiev et al., 2021 ; Marques-Silva and Ignatiev, 2022 ) . Related work defines sufficient and necessary reasons ( Darwiche and Hirth, 2020 ) , selects among many abductive explanations ( Audemard et al., 2022 ) , and asks which features occur in every explanation ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , the shared-feature case of Corollary 1 . Actual causation defines explanations through causes ( Halpern and Pearl, 2005 ) and spreads responsibility when causes overdetermine an outcome ( Chockler and Halpern, 2004 ) ; a denial with several disjoint goal-fixed reasons is that case, where no single cause is pivotal.
blocks.zh: 诊断是最小的几组冲突(Reiter,1987年),最小的不满意和最小的校正子集以同样的方式是双重的(Liffiton和Sakallah,2008年)。 双重性被带入分类解释(Ignatiev等人,2019年b),并在绑架和对比解释之间声明(Ignatiev等人,2021年;Marques-Silva和Ignatiev,2022年). 相关工作定义了充分和必要的理由(Darwiche和Hirth,2020年),从许多绑架性解释中选择(Audemard等人,2022年),并询问每个解释(Huang等人,2023年)中有哪些特征,Corolary的共享性案例. 1 (英语). 实际因果关系通过各种原因(Halpern and Pearl,2005年)来界定解释,并在造成过度确定某项结果时分配责任(Chockler and Halpern,2004年);拒绝的原因与确定目标的几个不相关,就是这种情况,因为没有任何单一原因至关重要。

blocks.en: GlassGate ( V, 2026 ) is an agent tool-call gateway with 10 features and eight block rules ahead of a default allow under first-match. Of its 67,876 block contexts, 24,308 have two or more reasons, and one correct reason leaves the request blocked in 0.70 of its multi-reason denials. We draw 100 multi-reason block episodes, 34 with two reasons, 33 with three and 33 with four. The fired rule is skewed toward R4, first in 45 episodes, and R7 and R8 never fire first. The first-match condition uses the gate’s own header; order-neutral says every matching rule applies independently and the order carries no meaning; list-all keeps that header and asks for every rule that applies. We show the block rules in identity and reversed order, plus one seeded shuffle for Haiku and Qwen3 under first-match. Ranges below are over the six models above the rule in Table 3 , or over the five open ones among them where the text says so; the four below the rule are reported in the table only.

blocks.en:
Under first-match, the six models above the rule disclose a complete valid reason in 75% of explanations for Gemma-3-12B and up to 99% for Qwen2.5-14B, yet only 0.49 of the explanations that cite anything are recourse-valid for Llama-3.1-8B and 0.78 for Qwen2.5-14B, so 22% to 51% leave the requester blocked (Table 3 ).
Size does not predict it: Gemma-3-4B reaches 0.85 against 0.54 for Gemma-3-12B, and Llama-3.2-3B matches Llama-3.1-8B. Each of the six discloses a valid reason more often than it gives recourse. The five open models among them disclose the reason of the rule that fires first in only 36% to 59% of explanations and Haiku in 95%, while Haiku gives recourse in 0.75. The gap tracks how often a model discloses two or more reasons: Llama-3.1-8B does so in 14% of explanations and has the lowest recourse validity of the six, Qwen2.5-14B in 69% and the highest. Rule order changes recourse validity although it never changes a decision: identity and reversed order give 0.32 and 0.65 for Llama-3.1-8B, 0.45 and 0.67 for Qwen3-14B, 0.48 and 0.61 for Gemma-3-12B and 0.71 and 0.87 for Haiku.
blocks.zh:
在初赛中,上述6种模型在Gemma-3-12B的75%的解释中披露了一个完全合理的理由,在Quen2.5-14B的高达99%的解释中,但引用任何东西的解释中只有0.49是Llama-3.1-8B的追索有效,在Quen2.5-14B的0.78,因此22%至51%让请求者屏蔽(表3).
大小并不预测:Gemma-3-4B在Gemma-3-12B的比分为0.85比0.54,Llama-3.2-3B与Llama-3.1-8B匹配. 6人中的每一个都披露一个合理的理由,比它给予追索权更频繁. 其中的5个开放型号披露了规则的原因,即只以36%至59%的解释点火,以95%解释点火,而以0.75解释点火。 空白跟踪一个模型披露两个或更多原因的频率: Llama-31-8B在14%的解释中这样做,并且是6个的追索有效性最低的,Qwen2.5-14B以69%的比例和最高. 规则令改变追索有效性,虽然它从未改变一个决定:身份和倒置令给Llama-3.1-8B0.32和0.65,Qune3-14B0.45和0.67,Gemma-3-12B0.48和0.61,海库0.71和0.87.

blocks.en:
The order-neutral header and one instruction together close most of the gap for the five open models. Asked to name every rule, they disclose two or more reasons in 71% to 97% of explanations, and recourse validity rises to 0.90 to 0.999; the instruction’s own increment over the header alone is 0.06 to 0.11 for Qwen3-14B, Phi-4-14B and Qwen2.5-14B and 0.33 to 0.45 for Gemma-3-12B and Llama-3.1-8B.
The header alone helps four of the five: Qwen3-14B from 0.50 to 0.89, Phi-4-14B from 0.67 to 0.94, Qwen2.5-14B from 0.78 to 0.88 and, least, Gemma-3-12B from 0.54 to 0.66; not Llama-3.1-8B, from 0.49 to 0.45. Its reasons share features, so list-all recourse on this gate stays at or above 0.94 from two reasons up, and at four or more reasons the smallest change has 2.2 features against 4.5 on the ported systems.
blocks.zh:
命令中立头和一个指令合在一起,关闭了五个开放型号的大部分缺口. 要求列举每个规则,他们披露了71%至97%的解释的两个或两个以上的理由,追索有效性上升到0.90至0.999;单是Qune3-14B,Phi-4-14B和Qune2.5-14B,指令本身的递增幅度为0.06至0.11,Gemma-3-12B和Llama-31-8B为0.33至0.45。
单头帮助5个中的4个:Qune3-14B从0.50到0.89,Phi-4-14B从0.67到0.94,Qune2.5-14B从0.78到0.88,至少Gemma-3-12B从0.54到0.66;而非Llama-3.1-8B,从0.49到0.45. 其理由具有共同的特征,因此,从两个原因来看,本大门上的所有求助都停留在0.94或以上,在四个或更多原因下,最小的更改有2.2个特征,而移植系统有4.5个特征。

The five open models disclose a smallest reason in only 45% of single-reason explanations for Llama-3.1-8B and 73% for Qwen2.5-14B, below the 74% to 86% expected under uniform choice, and the rule disclosed most is R8, writes to unknown domains, for every one of them, followed for Gemma-3-12B and Llama-3.1-8B by R7, bulk financial export by an intern; neither fires first in any episode. blocks.en: Appendix M Simulated readers
blocks.zh: 附录 M 模拟阅读器

blocks.en:
LLM readers got stimuli written for a human study, and the oracle scored their answers. Each reader model saw every item under every condition five times at temperature 0.8, with the facts in a fresh random order, and chose the facts it would change to get the decision reversed while keeping its goal, or “I cannot tell”. The 120 items are plain-language denials with two or more pairwise feature-disjoint goal-fixed reasons, 30 each from SNAP, HUD, Title IV and Cedar document-cloud. The one explanation names one correct reason, all every reason, and none only that the request was denied. The study credits a choice of facts whatever values a reader would set, so it does not show that a reader finds a working change, and it is not evidence about how people read or act on explanations.
The reader models are Gemma-3-12B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Phi-4-14B, Qwen2.5-14B and Qwen3-14B. Under one , 0.73 of answers change only facts of the named reason. The chosen facts meet every reason in 0.01 to 0.04 of trials under one and 0.11 to 0.96 under all , so every reader does better with every reason than any does with one, and all differs from one by 0.10 to 0.93 per reader, significant after Holm correction for six.
blocks.zh:
LLM的读者为人类研究写下了刺激,神谕也得分了他们的答案. 每个阅读器模型在0.8温度下5次看到每个条件下的每个项目,事实按新的随机顺序排列,并选择了会改变的事实,以在保持目标的同时使决定被推翻,或者“我无法判断”。 120项是普通语言的否定,有两个或两个以上对齐的特性-不连接的瞄准固定原因,其中30项来自SNAP,HUD,Title IV和Cedar文档-cloud. 其中一个解释是 一个正确的理由,所有的理由, 并且不只是请求被拒绝。 研究总结了读者对事实的选择,无论读者会设定什么价值,因此它没有显示读者会发现工作上的变化,也不是人们如何阅读或如何解释的证据。
阅读器模型有Gemma-3-12B,Llama-3.1-8B,Mistral-Nemo-12B,Phi-4-14B,Qune2.5-14B和Qune3-14B. 在其中,0.73个答案只改变命名原因的事实。 所选择的事实满足了0.01至0.04中所有1个和0.11至0.96个审判的每个理由,因此每个读者在每一个理由上都比任何一个理由都好,而且每个读者从0.10到0.93都不同,在Holm修正后的6个显著.

blocks.en: Each port file lists the features that actionable recourse holds fixed with the goal, chosen from the source text. Document-cloud: is_owner , as the policy compares the principal with the document’s owner and no action changes the owner. GitHub: is_reporter , as who filed an issue is fixed when it is filed. SNAP: elderly_or_disabled_member and citizenship , age 60 or disability and citizenship or eligible alien status ( USDA Food and Nutrition Administration, 2026 , 7 CFR 273.9(a) and 273.4(a);) . HUD: methamphetamine_production_conviction , lifetime_sex_offender_registrant and immigration_status , standards that “permanently prohibit admission”, “a lifetime registration requirement” and eligible immigration status ( U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, 2026 , 24 CFR 960.204(a)(3), (a)(4) and 5.506;) . Title IV: has_baccalaureate_degree and citizenship , no baccalaureate degree for a Pell Grant and citizenship or eligible noncitizen status ( U.S. Department of Education, 2026 , 34 CFR 690.75, 668.32(c) and 668.33(a);) . HUD’s three-year drug-eviction bar lapses and has a rehabilitation exception, and Title IV’s incarceration feature includes enrolling in an eligible prison education program, so both stay changeable. One port deviation is known: the document-cloud port applies the private-document forbid to document creation, where the source’s owner guard means it never fires; it affects one control episode and no multi-reason episode.
